info.name: HUD User CHAS Income Limits API

params.name: entityid
params.description: HUD geographic entity identifier. For counties, use the 5-digit FIPS code. For metropolitan areas, use the CBSA code. For states, use the 2-digit FIPS code.

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year for income limit data

items.docs: Returns HUD Income Limits for a specific geographic entity at 30%, 50%, and 80% of Area Median Income (AMI) by household size (1-8 persons).

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g., CA, TX, NY)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year for income limit data

items.docs: Returns income limit data for all geographic areas within the specified state, including counties and metropolitan areas.
